mapper.select: select u.id, u.login_name as username, u.display_name as displayName from auth_session s join admin_user u on u.id::varchar = s.subject_id where s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} and s.actor_type = 'admin' and s.expires_at > current_timestamp and s.revoked_at is null and u.status = 'active'
mapper.delete: delete from auth_session where expires_at <= #{now} or revoked_at is not null
